selected.title: SoFi launches tokenised deposits
selected.summary: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI), the everything app for digital financial services, today announced the launch of SoFi Earn (SOFIE), the first and only national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers.
selected.why: First national bank-issued tokenised deposit for consumers launched by SoFi.

reason: SoFi's tokenized deposits raise genuine debate about whether bank-issued tokens reduce or increase systemic risk and whether they represent genuine innovation or regulatory arbitrage.
angle: Bank-issued tokenized deposits may increase financial instability by fragmenting deposit markets and complicating central bank policy transmission, not enhance it.
